metadata.raw_topology: Building parcel 379 exactly occupies one interior ring of parcel 505/2 and shares its boundary. Treating the two raw polygons as a literal MultiPolygon would be topologically invalid.
metadata.geometry_derivation: Shapely 2.1.2 unary_union using GEOS 3.13.1 on the two exact returned polygon geometries. The result is one valid Polygon with one exterior and 15 interior rings; no interpolation or analyst-drawn vertex contributed.
